# Get Event Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given event.

## Syntax

~~~~text
eventDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, event: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
eventDetail(detail: Start Date, event: Jellycuts Release Date)
~~~~
